[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor = }} '''Brotherhood knights''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} In the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]], knights are mid-ranking active duty combatants who are equipped with [[power armor]]. The chapter's [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]] are trained to serve knights as [[Squire (TV series)|squires]]. Aside from various unnamed knights, they are known to include [[Titus|Knight Titus]], [[Gnatius|Knight Gnatius]], [[Riley (TV series)|Knight Riley]], and the [[:File:Shady Sands Knight and Maximus.png|knight]] who found [[Maximus]] after the [[Fall of Shady Sands|destruction]] of [[Shady Sands]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Several Brotherhood knights arrive at the Brotherhood base from the ''[[The Prydwen|Prydwen]]''. When Maximus is interrogated by [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]] for the suspicion of Dane's leg injury, a knight participates in it, too, by standing by. {{Quotation|All that remains of America is the overwhelming evidence of its failure.|sound=Lacerta Legate Evidence of its failure.ogg|To Lucy in "[[The Profligate]]"}}

The '''Lacerta Legate''' is a high-ranking member and later leader of [[Caesar's Legion]] after declaring himself the new '''Caesar''' in the [[Mojave Wasteland]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. He appears in [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]] of {{In|FOTV}} and {{in|FOS|noin}}.

==Background==
Nothing is known about his history with Caesar's Legion. At some point prior to 2296, he gained the rank of legate in service to one of the two figures claiming to be [[Caesar (TV series)|Caesar]] in the midst of the [[Legion civil war|Legion's succession crisis and civil war]]. As such, he regards the leader of the other faction within the Legion as a "[[false Caesar]]."
